svg.title: Oracle · full native dependency atlas
svg.desc: All 28 Oracle nodes and exact prerequisite edges, combining original Lab subject artifacts with later truth evidence while preserving subject-only grounding.
svg.text: 28 native nodes · 53 declared dependencies · arrows point to the consumer
Subject mirrors ← original Lab run. Global feed nodes ← later truth snapshot. These are runtime bindings, not graph edges.
Subject index / numerical diffs → six lane reviews → Truth map → Attribution / Explain → reconstructed Oracle CP2.
Oracle CP2 retains original subject eligibility; hindsight and explanation do not create admissible evidence or new targets.
TOOL: source or deterministic operation REASONING: model operator Green: frozen Lab/Oracle checkpoints
Repeated cards name the same artifact. Each declared edge appears once; no skip edges are omitted.
Research prototype. This is not financial advice.
